{
  "app": "LEVI ZEUS TUNER PRO - A14",
  "package_target": "com.dts.freefiremax",
  "required_permissions": [
    {
      "name": "WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS",
      "permission": "android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS",
      "description": "Permite alterar sem_performance_mode, display_density_forced, game_overlay",
      "adb_command": "adb shell pm grant com.levi.zeustuner android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS",
      "shizuku_command": "adb shell appops set com.levi.zeustuner WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS allow"
    },
    {
      "name": "WRITE_SETTINGS",
      "permission": "android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS",
      "description": "Permite high_touch_sensitivity, view_touch_slop",
      "adb_command": "adb shell pm grant com.levi.zeustuner android.permission.WRITE_SETTINGS"
    },
    {
      "name": "DEVICE_CONFIG",
      "permission": "android.permission.WRITE_DEVICE_CONFIG",
      "description": "Permite input_native_boot e game_overlay",
      "adb_command": "adb shell device_config set_sync_disabled_for_tests persistent"
    }
  ],
  "ladb_commands_to_enable_tuner": [
    "settings put global sem_performance_mode 1",
    "settings put global gpu_tuner_enabled 1",
    "settings put system high_touch_sensitivity_enabled 1",
    "device_config put input_native_boot tap_slop 2",
    "settings put system view_touch_slop 2",
    "device_config put input_native_boot swipe_touch_slop 6",
    "device_config put game_overlay com.dts.freefiremax mode=performance,downscaleFactor=1.0,lowLatency=1,highFpsStutterFix=1,loadingBoost=1,useAngle=true",
    "settings put global wifi_suspend_optimizations_enabled 0",
    "wm density 320"
  ],
  "stretch_modes": {
    "original": {
      "density": 420,
      "size": "1080x2400",
      "downscale": 1.0
    },
    "esticada_90": {
      "density": 360,
      "size": "1080x2160",
      "downscale": 0.9
    },
    "super_esticada": {
      "density": 320,
      "size": "1080x1920",
      "downscale": 0.85
    },
    "ultra_wide": {
      "density": 380,
      "size": "1260x2400",
      "downscale": 1.0
    }
  },
  "presets": {
    "ZEUS_LISO": {
      "commands": [
        "settings put global sem_performance_mode 1",
        "device_config put input_native_boot tap_slop 2",
        "settings put system view_touch_slop 2",
        "device_config put input_native_boot swipe_touch_slop 6",
        "device_config put game_overlay com.dts.freefiremax mode=performance,downscaleFactor=1.0,lowLatency=1,highFpsStutterFix=1"
      ]
    },
    "MINATO": {
      "commands": [
        "device_config put input_native_boot velocity_tracker_strategy 2",
        "settings put system scroll_friction 10",
        "device_config put game_overlay com.dts.freefiremax downscaleFactor=0.9"
      ]
    },
    "STRETCH": {
      "commands": [
        "wm density 320",
        "wm size 1080x1920",
        "device_config put game_overlay com.dts.freefiremax downscaleFactor=0.85,useAngle=true"
      ]
    }
  }
}
